title: Ornamental Facade Composer with Energy Budget
description: The user designs a decorative building facade by placing Corset ornaments and Duck gargoyles onto a procedural grid of mounting slots across a classical wall. Each ornament has a weight cost drawn from a fixed energy budget, and the user must balance symmetry, coverage, and budget while using undo/redo to refine their composition.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an architectural facade decoration tool. Scene setup: Generate a flat rectangular stone-textured wall (12 units wide, 8 tall) with a 4x3 grid of circular mounting slots highlighted as glowing rings. Add directional light simulating afternoon sun plus ambient light. Position the camera with OrbitControls looking at the wall front-on. Load Corset.glb and Duck.glb using GLTFLoader. The Corset represents a classical rosette ornament (scale to ~0.6 units) and the Duck represents a gargoyle waterspout (scale to ~0.8 units, rotated to face outward). Display an HTML overlay showing: current Energy Budget starting at 100 units, a symmetry score percentage, placement count, and undo/redo buttons. Interaction flow (10-14 steps expected): The user clicks a toolbar toggle to select either Corset (cost 8 energy) or Duck (cost 12 energy), then clicks any empty mounting slot to place a clone there with a snap animation. Placing an ornament deducts its cost from the budget (conservation law: total placed cost + remaining budget always equals 100). The symmetry score auto-calculates by comparing left-half placements to mirrored right-half placements. If the user places a Duck on both horizontally mirrored slots, award a 5-point symmetry bonus shown as a floating +5 particle. Clicking an occupied slot removes the ornament and refunds its energy cost. Implement full undo/redo stacks (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y and buttons) that restore both the grid state and budget atomically. When budget reaches 0 or all 12 slots are filled, display a completion panel showing final symmetry score and a star rating (1-3 stars based on symmetry percentage thresholds 50/75/90). Add a subtle pulsing glow on slots that would create a mirror pair if filled, guiding the user toward symmetry. All placed ornaments should cast shadows onto the wall. Include a reset button that clears everything back to initial state.
